name: Sitting in Assembly
arabic: ((عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه قَاَلَ: كَانَ يُعَدُّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَجْلِسِ الوَاحِدِ مِائَةُ مَرَّةٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَقُومَ: ((رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الغَفُورُ)).

metadata.reference: Tirmidhiu dhe të tjerë, “Sahih et-Tirmidhi” 3/153 dhe “Sahih Ibën Maxheh” 2/321.

transliterations.latin: Rabbi-gfir li ve tub alejje, inneke Ente et-Tevvabul-Gafur

translations.albanian: O Zoti im, më fal dhe ma prano pendimin, sepse Ti je Pranues i faljes dhe i pendimit.
translations.english: (Ibn AAumar  said: It would be counted that the Messenger of Allah  would say one hundred times at any one sitting before getting up: (O my Lord, forgive me and turn towards me (to accept my repentance). Verily You are The Oft-Returning. The Oft-Forgiving.))
translations.indonesian: Ya Allah! Berilah berkah buah-buahan kami, berilah berkah kota kami, berilah berkah gantangan kami (sehingga di antara kami tidak sering mengurangi timbangan) dan berilah berkah mud kami.
